description: Check a DKIM public key record (the TXT record published at <selector>._domainkey.<domain>) before you publish it or when DKIM fails. Send the record text (for example 'v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBg...'), and optionally the selector and domain. Get back whether verifiers can use the record at all (read_by_verifiers is false when they discard it or it gives no usable key), the key type (rsa or ed25519), the key length in bits (read from the key itself), whether the key is revoked (empty p=) or in testing mode (t=y), the allowed hashes and service types, the strict-subdomain flag, the key's SHA-256 fingerprint, and each problem with its RFC: no p tag, a key under 1024 bits (cannot validate) or under 2048 (below the recommended size), a key that is not valid base64 or not a real key, a hash list with no SHA-256. No DNS query is made. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/dkim-record-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

domain.description: Optional: the signing domain, to name the DNS record the key belongs at.

record.description: The DKIM key TXT record text (several strings of one TXT record joined without spaces).

selector.description: Optional: the selector, to name the DNS record the key belongs at.

name: dkim_record_check
title: DKIM Record Check (RFC 6376)
